name: Baked Room Viewer
description: Full-screen interactive 3D isometric room with baked lighting that visitors orbit and zoom by dragging, with a loading progress screen and a reset view button.
contents: Full-screen WebGL canvas showing a baked-texture room model
Loading overlay with title and progress bar
Reset viewport button and drag/zoom hint pill
behavior: Loads a GLB model and baked texture with Three.js
Orbit, zoom and pan with damping, zoom limited by min and max distance
Reset button returns the camera to its start position

props.name: hintText
props.default: Drag to Orbit • Scroll to Zoom

editableByProps: Model and texture files, background and loader colors
Grass mesh color and camera zoom limits

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the starting camera position or field of view
needsCodeEdit.where: PerspectiveCamera and camera.position.set calls in init

needsCodeEdit.change: Use a different mesh name for the recolored part

fixed: Root is fixed to the full viewport and covers the page
Recolored mesh is named Pasto in the model
Camera and canvas sized from the window, not the container
